Hi all —

Confirming Redwood finance acceptance criteria (vendor onboarding):
- W-9: completed and signed (PDF OK).
- EIN proof: official IRS CP575 letter or equivalent documentation showing EIN assignment, or a copy of filed tax return page that shows EIN (redact financials).
- Bank verification: one of the following — bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account ownership (dated within 90 days), voided check, or an ACH micro-deposit confirmation after we kick off setup (if HelixPath prefers this flow).
- Signatory: government ID for the person authorized to sign bank agreements (scan of passport or driver's license).

If HelixPath can provide the bank letter and EIN confirmation, we'll process vendor onboarding within 2 business days and release payment on our next AP run (we pay 30 days net unless otherwise agreed). If you need an expedited wire for this invoice, indicate that in reply and include beneficiary details — we'll request approval from Treasury (Aditya).

Best,
